lines.text: No matter who you are, no matter what you've done,
the pop stars of your dreams will always smile for you.
You're cordially invited to join T.T. STAR for the Smile Time project.
Behind the outdoor stage, the same advertisement plays over and over on a massive screen.
Anis, Mint, and Prika stand at the center stage, staring blankly ahead.
Anis glances over her shoulder at the line of bodyguards behind them.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Uh... I heard we're just supposed to smile and go along with whatever they want. That's gonna be okay, right?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Bit much with the bodyguards, don't you think?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: I guess it really is different with big companies. They even have security for something like this.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Riss, you heard anything else?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: N-no, I was just told you only have to smile...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: That's it? Heck, I'm a natural at that.
*Thump*
A heavy hand lands on Anis's shoulder.
She jumps and spins around.
A bodyguard stares down at her with icy eyes, pressing a finger to his lips in a warning.
Her chest tightens, a cold knot twisting in her stomach.
Forcing herself to look forward, she sees a line of people waiting.
The first person in line steps forward.
They introduce themselves as a fan who's been following them since their Meet & Meat days,
and ask if they can take a photo with all three of them.
Smiling, the girls pose for the picture.
The next fan steps up.
They ask the three of them to form a big heart with their arms.
The girls smile and oblige.
Delighted, the fan snaps a photo and leaves.
Another fan comes up.
He introduces himself as Robert,
and asks Mint to shout, "I love you, Robert."
Mint flinches for a split second, then smiles and yells it out.
The fan leaves, replaying the recording again and again.
The next fan steps forward.
They want a photo with them standing between Anis and Prika.
As they move into position, they try to slip an arm around both Anis and Prika's waists.
A bodyguard steps in quietly and stops them.
With an awkward smile, Anis rests a hand on the fan's shoulder. Prika follows her lead, and they take the photo together.
At that moment, Anis realizes she could do this all day and thinks, "So this is what connecting with fans feels like."
The thought sends a light warmth through her chest.
Another fan approaches,
glancing at the bodyguards. One of them gives an almost imperceptible nod.
The fan trips, sending the coffee cup in their hand flying.
Coffee splashes across Prika's uniform.
The fan panics, apologizing over and over.
Watching from the side, Hanson flinches.
Prika looks startled for a moment, then quickly smiles it off and reassures the fan that it's fine.
The other fans hesitate. Seeing that, Anis waves them over.
They ask for certain poses and lines, snapping photos and recording short videos.
And just like that, the first day of the Smile Time project comes to an end.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: No way, we're up another spot?!

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: I didn't think an event like that would make such a difference.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-it was an event with Tetra's name all over it,

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: so it's safe to treat it as one of their official event.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I think what the fans were thinking is that T.T. STAR is going to be pushed into the mainstream with Tetra backing them

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: so we should take advantage of these early events while we can.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: A-and later, when they really make it big, it won't be this easy to take photos anymore...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Hey... you okay, Prika? How's the coffee spill?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Yeah, I'm fine. Riss got me a new uniform right away.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: ... Something about it feels off.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Huh? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: ... Nothing, I'm probably overreacting.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wait, we're not performing?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Um, yeah. For now, we're focusing on promotions. Once things start picking up, that's when we'll move to performances.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Th-they think it's more effective to go big once, rather than do a lot of smaller shows.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Okay, guess we better get some practice in.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Um... they said you're not allowed to practice on days you have an event scheduled.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-it's so you don't overdo it...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Are you serious? That's crazy.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-it's Tetra, after all. Anyway, we have an event early tomorrow morning, so let's call it a day.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: All right! Get some rest, we're going all out again tomorrow!
Anis is sure now.
She has brushed off the drink spilled on her earlier as an accident.
Two days in a row? She has chalked it up to rotten luck.
Even when sticky syrup started coming at her in strange, deliberate arcs toward her chest? She tells herself she was overthinking it.
But now, there's no denying it.
The instant she sees the ice cream flying straight at her face, she knows.
This is intentional.
She dodges, and the ice cream hits the floor with a splat.
Her gaze snaps to the fan who had been grinning expectantly just moments ago.
Now, that expression warps into panic. Anis strides toward them,
or she tries to.
A heavy hand clamps down on her shoulder.
Her eyes flick to the bodyguard behind her.
"Smile," he says. Empty eyes stare back at her from behind sunglasses.
And in that instant, everything falls into place.
So that's how it is.
Both Mint and Prika also reach the same conclusion.
They've been tossed out here like toys.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Don't screw with me, you little—
*Splat*
Prika scoops up the fallen ice cream and smears it straight into her face.
She grins through the mess.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Thank you for coming to Smile Time.
Anis and Mint watch Prika forcing a smile that's already starting to crack.
They know exactly what comes next if this falls apart.
Crippling penalties. Corporate retaliation.
Their future comes into focus with brutal clarity.
A star-shaped sticker that has been trampled into the floor until all its shine is gone.
With that in mind, the members of T.T. STAR smile.
They swallow down the sobs clawing at their throats,
forcing their trembling lips into something that almost looks real.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: How dare you treat them like this?!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Whoa, easy there. What's got you all riled up?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Stop this at once! What do you think you're doing, offering them up as toys to the public?

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Think you can afford the penalty?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, I'll pay! Even if it takes the rest of my life, I'll pay every last bit of it! So we're done!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Well? What do you girls think?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Don't speak to my pop stars!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Well, well, look how high you've climbed.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Ninth place. Top 10 already, hm? That's a big step toward your major debut.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Don't listen to him. We can always raise the rankings back up.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: There's no reason for you to be treated like this. We can do it the right way.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You know this isn't right.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: So let's stop here. We can start over.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You really think playing by the rules makes you special?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Quiet, now!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Let's go, girls.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: We're not letting greed steer us off course. Even if it takes longer, we'll do this properly.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Boss,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: we—

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, Anis, don't say it.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: W-we

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: can still keep going a little longer!

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: ... Heh.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Y-yeah, some fans pulled some crap, but way more came to support us.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: And, uh... if this is all we're up against, we can handle it.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: I feel the same. This level of attention isn't something you can just ask for.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: If it's simply part of what we have to endure to rise higher, then I think we can handle it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: And the penalty fee? Let's be real, there's no way we can ever pay that.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Don't worry, we're good at surviving the grind.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... You think this is as far as it goes?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: They can do far worse. They will do far worse.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Pfft, that wouldn't matter. The bodyguards behind me will stop anyone from getting that close in the first place.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Exactly, nothing gets through unless I allow it.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Thanks, Boss, but we've got this.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: We'll handle it like we always do. Together.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Anis, let me say this again...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: The mainstream...

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I... wanna get there.
Mustang claps his hands so hard it echoes through the place.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Good, so you've made your choice.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I can see the fire in all of you. I like it! As someone who runs the world of entertainment, this is exactly the kind of thrill I live for.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: I'll back you with everything I've got. Now let's see how you fare in the mainstream.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Ah... yeah, I-I'm counting on you.
Mustang looks at Hanson.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: You'll want to hurry.

lines.speaker: mustang_past
lines.text: Time's not exactly on our side.
T.T. STAR's dorm buzzes with energy.
Hanson watches the members as they chatter excitedly about the future.
It doesn't take long for him to realize they're pushing themselves, trying to hide their anxiety.
Even so, he can't bring himself to cheer them on
since he knows exactly what kind of man Mustang is and what will happen next.
There is nothing he can do.
One after another, people fall for Mustang's empty promises, hurling themselves into the fire without hesitation.
And the fire consumes them all the same.
The weight of helplessness presses down on him.
He doesn't think he can talk those girls out of the future they're so desperate to believe in.
Still, he has to act.
He needs a way to overturn everything in a single move,
even if it means going to extremes.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... Everyone, I think I'll need to be away for a while.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Huh? What for?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I have something important to to take care of. It's rather urgent.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Hey, Boss. About earlier...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No, it's okay. I understand. I'm sorry, I got a bit carried away.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I might be hard to reach while I'm away. Will that be all right?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Oh, yeah, sure.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Got something important to take care of?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Yes, it's something I have to do.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: ... Yeah, got it. Just make it back in one piece.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: We'll manage, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: ... All right, get some rest.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll see you soon.
That night, Hanson lies awake until morning.
At first light, he sets out.
His eyes burn with a resolve he's never shown before.
